why: wiki/canary-watch.md: XLP 30-day correlation to SPY flipped from -0.109 to +0.173, one of two defensive sign flips this week.
wiki/economic-calendar.md: UMich September preliminary sentiment at 47.8, the second-lowest on record, is the classic setup for a defensive rotation.
wiki/canary-watch.md: with the 10Y at 4.975% the staple dividend yield competes against a near-5% risk-free alternative, which caps the upside.
risks: If the 10Y breaks 5.00% the yield competition overwhelms the defensive bid.
The defensive rotation is two weeks old; a single risk-on session would unwind the correlation flip.
